essence: The twice-born may use either circular or square ritual platforms.
The teacher should perform the village circumambulation and water consecration as before.
The ritual resting and bathing should be performed separately on the platform above the altar.
One should perform the auspicious thread rite and bed ascending separately, following the earlier procedure.
While placing the time pot near the head, one should remember its mantra.
